sample_unit: psychiatrists (responses compared with ChatGPT-4o answers to standardized antidepressant questions)

links.outcome: ChatGPT-4o versus psychiatrists on accuracy, conciseness, readability, clarity for antidepressant questions
links.effect: Accuracy comparable (P = .0645); ChatGPT more concise (P = .0019); readability not different (P = .0892); psychiatrists clearer (P = .0059).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o showed comparable accuracy to psychiatrists (P = .0645) but was significantly more concise (P = .0019).

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT-4o responses versus responses from 26 psychiatrists answering standardized antidepressant questions, evaluated offline for accuracy, conciseness, readability, and clarity without testing a deployment practice.
